page.layout: One printed page of text, with the running head centred at the top and the page number at top right. Below the running head: a title, a verse passage in stanzas, and "FINIS". No notes in the margins. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf runs through the centre and is left out.

main_text.head: Temporis ratio habenda.
main_text.p: Dum licet ingenio ditari, disce iuventus: Iste dabit fruges, iste colendus ager.
Cætera fide Deo qui presfis subvenit: Ille Excubias nostro pro grege semper agit.
main_text.head: Quatuor quotidie cogitanda.
main_text.p: Mors Christi, tua mors, infernus, gloria cœli: Quatuor hæc semper sunt meditanda tibi.
main_text.head: Precatio Ecclesiæ ad Christum.
main_text.p: Audi nunc gemitus, & vota precantia Christe: Reijce net surda supplicis aure preces.
Me tibi commendo, tibi me iam porrigo Christe: Tu clemens famulum protege Christe tuum.

page.notes: The scan is of a single page with the binding edge on the right. Left-edge fragments are the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Some words are slightly blurred ("net", "presfis", "Reijce"), but the readings given are the printed forms as they appear. Printed spelling is kept, including "net" and "presfis".
